label: Iron Blaze
description: Bold red on near-black with a burnt-orange accent. Energetic, modern and intense — suits gyms, fitness centres, CrossFit boxes and combat sports studios.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. The dark bg and bold red primary give this theme its gym-floor energy. Sections with default bg will be transparent (inheriting the page's near-black) while surface (e.g. gallery, team) lifts content off that same dark background. The burnt orange accent is dark enough to pass WCAG AA at 5:1 against white text. Changing `primary` here restyles every section, every page, instantly.
